# Flatten

Flattens an array of arrays, at every level of nesting, into one array.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Flatten(items)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array | The array to flatten, which is left unchanged. Null is read as the empty array; any other type that is not an array is a runtime error. An array that holds itself, directly or through other arrays, is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Array. A new array holding every element of items that is not an array, in order, with each nested array replaced by its own elements, flattened the same way. Objects, and null elements, are kept as they are. Never null.

## Example

`Flatten([1, [2, [3, [4]]]])` returns `[1, 2, 3, 4]`.
